field_definitions: same metric fields as routes.json (see routes.json field_definitions)
oxygen_model: relative_effort in hours of suit supply at 1200 BTU/h; see route_model.json. Not validated for Mars.
comms_point_definition: nearest walkable cell with straight line of sight to a 3.0 m antenna at the habitat, suit antenna 1.8 m (assumed heights)

frame.name: local ENU from habitat
frame.note: east_m/north_m are ground metres from the habitat. lat/lon are planetocentric degrees, longitude positive east, Mars 2000 sphere (R = 3,396,190 m). x_m/y_m are coordinates in the DTM's equirectangular projection (standard parallel 0, central meridian 0). This is NOT RFC 7946 (Earth WGS84) GeoJSON.
